scope: Two isolated concurrent loopback HTTP fixtures and paced finite consumers. No app/profile/account/audio/CDN access.
limitations: Constant byte-rate consumption approximates source-byte demand and is not real decoding/audio output.
Two loopback fixtures run concurrently but have independent proxy/network state and identical latency schedule.
OS TCP, Node and Undici buffering can hide a slow block; total observed arrival lead includes these plus owned compressed buffers and application buffer.
Configured credit bounds derive from separately tested source; this harness observes real active transport and byte lead, not every private allocation.
Fixed synthetic authorization resolver does not exercise real60s metadata refresh or original QQ caches.
